provenance.steps: Each loan has a 2024-01-31 row with balance 100 and one 2024-02-29 row testing one side of an event rule; maturity 2030-06-15 unless the row tests the maturity month (2024-02-20, or 2024-03-20 for MATURITY a month early). Accepted rows satisfy the balance identity and exposure. NONE: prepaid 0.0001 or balance 0 is E14. PARTIAL: prepaid 0.0001 accepted; prepaid 0 or balance 0 is E14. FULL: balance 0 with prepaid 0.0001 accepted; prepaid 0, balance 0.0001 or the maturity month is E14. MATURITY: accepted in the maturity month; a month early or balance 0.0001 is E14. DEFAULT and SALE: prepaid 0.0001 is E14. RENEG: zero residual (scheduled 100) and T = 0.005 need no successor and are accepted (D15); T = 0.0051 without a successor is E16 on its row; a zero-residual RENEG named by successor R_ZS2 is E16 on R_ZS2 (D15); opening 100, scheduled 120, other_change 20, closing 0 is E14 although the identity holds; prepaid 100, closing 50 and other_change -99 against -100 are E14. zero-residual: the two accepted zero-residual rows alone, accepted. Warnings are not asserted.
